_comment: Lazy Lifetime Analysis, drawn by emtk's view_form over the Qt-free LLTFModel (gui/model.py): fields are its attrs, `enabled(name)` greys what the Qt wizard greyed. The file rows (decay, IRF, configuration with its editor, output directory) are the custom `lltf_files` section the app draws; the Results panel is drawn in the Results tab.

sections.label: Number of Lifetimes
sections.description: Exponential components of the fit. Used when Find Optimal is off; it then also switches the configuration file's own find_optimal off.

sections.label: Find Optimal
sections.description: Find the optimal number of lifetimes: fit 1 … Max Lifetimes components and pick a count by the probability test. Read the χ²ᵣ sequence (Analysis Output, or optimal_fitting in the JSON) rather than taking the count as a verdict.

sections.label: Max Lifetimes to Try
sections.description: Largest component count the search fits.

sections.label: Probability Threshold
sections.description: Probability a further component must reach to be kept. At the default 0.68 it needs about a 14 % drop in reduced χ², whatever the photon count.

sections.label: Verbose Output
sections.description: Print the fitter's progress and diagnostics in Analysis Output.

columns.label: Amplitude
columns.description: Species fraction; the fractions sum to 1 (not intensity fractions).
